flowContents.name: StreamerResearch
flowContents.comments: Daily external research per roster streamer → kind=research points in streamer-kb (#271 K5). Streamers track — not part of the DGX guide.

parameters.name: Postgres Password
parameters.description: Sensitive — set via the API after upload from ~/.env STREAMER_BRAIN_DB_PASSWORD; never in this file.

parameters.name: Postgres Driver Jar
parameters.description: Ships in the CFM NiFi image.

parameters.name: Twitch Client Secret
parameters.description: Sensitive — set via the API from ~/.env TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET; never in this file.

parameters.name: Max Tokens
parameters.description: Answer budget for the two research texts.

parameters.name: Twitch Client Id
parameters.description: Twitch app client id (Helix app token). Set via the API from ~/.env TWITCH_CLIENT_ID; never in this file.

parameters.name: News Window Days
parameters.description: Google News `when:` window for what is circulating.

parameters.name: Qdrant URL
parameters.description: qdrant-kb (docker); the streamer-kb collection lives here.

parameters.name: Postgres User
parameters.description: SELECT on the streamer_brain view only.

parameters.name: vLLM Base URL
parameters.description: The box's vLLM (docker, LAN-published); pods reach it at the LAN address.

StreamerResearch.description: Endpoints and credentials the StreamerResearch PG uses (Streamers track).
